svg.title: When the network goes, the phone goes dark
svg.desc: −55%: card payments in Spain on 28 April 2025, the day of the blackout, against a normal Monday (Banco de España). under 4%: of Spain’s cash machines had their own backup power; the rest went dark with the grid (Banco de España). 768,000: customers lost power in Ireland when Storm Éowyn hit on 24 January 2025 (ESB Networks). 72 h: the EU now encourages people to keep essential supplies for at least 72 hours of an emergency (European Commission).
